prompt:

Asset type: horizontal mobile mini-program membership tier banner, to be used as an image background behind native UI text
Primary request: Create one premium abstract banner for v1 普通会员 in the InwardClub membership benefits page.
Style: premium private club, black/white/gray foundation, matte pearl white and graphite black, calm low contrast, subtle paper grain, understated private club membership feel. Cinematic product-material lighting, clean negative space, sophisticated, minimal, not childish.
Composition: wide horizontal banner composition, safe empty area in the upper-left/center-left for native text overlay, visual interest toward the right side, soft depth, no hard borders.
Text policy: absolutely no text, no Chinese characters, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
